notes.title: A new look for your console
notes.body: Live orders, History, Menu, Hours, Payouts and Settings share one layout, with the navigation on the left.

notes.title: New orders at the top of every page
notes.body: A new order waits in a strip at the top of every page. Open it to accept or decline, and the order sound rings until you answer.

notes.title: Settings, one section at a time
notes.body: Settings opens one section at a time and edits open in a panel beside it. This device holds the sound, notification and screen settings for the browser you are using.
